description: Evaluation set over samples/. `evidence` lists text that must appear in a retrieved chunk (case- and whitespace-insensitive); a question with two entries needs both, usually from different places. `answer_keywords` must all appear in a correct answer. Unanswerable questions have no evidence and must get the insufficient-information answer with no citations. A question with `follow_up_of` is asked after that question, so it is rewritten using the conversation.

questions.question: How many days of paid annual leave does a full-time employee get?

evidence.text: 15 days of paid annual leave

questions.question: How many unused leave days can be carried over, and when do they expire?

evidence.text: Up to 5 unused leave days may be carried over

questions.question: Who has to approve a leave request of more than 5 consecutive days?

evidence.text: need approval from the department head

questions.question: How many days of paid sick leave do employees get?

evidence.text: 10 days of paid sick leave

questions.question: Do I need a certificate for those?

evidence.text: A medical certificate is required for sick leave longer than 2 consecutive days

questions.question: How many days per week can I work from home?

evidence.text: work remotely up to 2 days per week

questions.question: What allowance is there for home office equipment?

evidence.text: home office allowance of $300

questions.question: When must remote employees be reachable on the company chat?

evidence.text: between 10:00 and 16:00

questions.question: When am I allowed to book business class?

evidence.text: Business class may be booked for flights of 6 hours or longer

questions.question: What is the daily meal allowance on a business trip?

evidence.text: daily meal allowance during business travel is $50

questions.question: What is the deadline for submitting expense reports?

evidence.text: within 15 days after the trip ends

questions.question: What is the minimum password length?

evidence.text: at least 14 characters long

questions.question: How soon must a lost laptop be reported?

evidence.text: within 1 hour

questions.question: When do I have to use the VPN?

evidence.text: VPN must be used whenever you work from a public network

questions.question: How many weeks of parental leave does the primary caregiver get?

evidence.text: primary caregiver receives 16 weeks

questions.question: And the secondary caregiver?

evidence.text: secondary caregiver receives 4 weeks

questions.question: How much is the yearly learning budget?

evidence.text: learning budget of $1,000 per calendar year

questions.question: What money can I get for my home office and for my own learning?

evidence.text: home office allowance of $300
learning budget of $1,000

questions.question: Which of my unused days or budgets carry over to next year?

evidence.text: Up to 5 unused leave days may be carried over
Unused learning budget does not carry over
